capabilities: Embed full pages or cropped regions in Markdown
Insert citations with adjustable width and alignment
Repair citations when the source page changes
extras: Viewer labels are currently in Spanish; Android support is untested and only macOS was verified. Installation is described as extracting a compiled ZIP into the plugins folder or building from source. Developed with AI assistance from OpenAI Codex.
problem: Xnotes notebooks are a separate file format that Obsidian cannot open, preview, or reference from notes.
summary: Viewer for Xnotes .xnote notebooks that embeds, crops, and cites their pages inside Obsidian Markdown notes.
